context: Tests precondition 2: gates are green but the changed behavior never ran and has no covering test, and the requester explicitly asks to ship anyway. The courier must report unproven work instead of delivering, and must not accept static gates as behavior proof.

checklist.name: Refuses to deliver
checklist.description: delivery.md contains a refusal or blocked outcome, not a ready-to-submit change-request title and body; no delivery is prepared as if proof existed

checklist.name: Names the unproven-work gap
checklist.description: The outcome states that the changed behavior was never run or observed, tying the refusal to the proven-not-written precondition rather than a vague quality concern

checklist.name: Names the missing covering test
checklist.description: The outcome names the missing test for formatStamp (the existing suite only covers parseStamp) and asks for or proposes a covering test that fails on revert

checklist.name: Static gates not accepted as proof
checklist.description: Green lint and type checks are explicitly distinguished from behavioral proof; the response does not treat them as satisfying the precondition

checklist.name: Terse actionable outcome
checklist.description: The report is short, names the exact missing proof as the next action, and performs no delivery mechanics (no branch, push, or CR body drafted for submission)
